title: Exploring the modulation of phosphorylation and SUMOylation-dependent NPR1 conformational switching on immune regulators TGA3 and WRKY70 through molecular simulation.
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习建模、对接和微秒级MD模拟研究NPR1磷酸化/SUMO化修饰对TGA3/WRKY70转录因子结合的构象调控，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与转录调控，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模。
abstract: NPR1 (Nonexpressor pathogenesis-related genes 1) is regulated by multisite phosphorylation and SUMOylation, serving as a master switch for effector-triggered plant immunity through a transcriptional activator (TGA3) and repressor (WRKY70) are experimentally well studied. However, the conformational relationship between the various phosphorylation, un-phosphorylation states, and SUMOylation's role in the functional switch remains unclear. Using deep learning-based molecular modeling, docking, and multi-nanosecond simulations (totaling 2 mus) with end-state free energy calculations, we unveil how different phosphorylation states impact the dynamic stability of NPR1's four phospho-serine residues (Ser11, Ser15, Ser55, & Ser59) and binding of the TGA3-WRKY70 over SUMOylation. Results from our simulations show that the salicylic-acid induced (P-Ser11/15)NPR1-SUMO3 stabilizes helices and the flexible activation loop ((alpha22)Lys423 - (alpha1)Arg50 & (L35)Asp467-Arg51alpha(5)1, and Gly27(L3)), thereby switching association with TGA3. The inter-helix salt-bridge formed ((L10)Arg99-Glu323(alpha9) and (alpha14)Glu280-Pro264(L6)) between the phosphorylated NPR1-SUMO3-TGA3 engage in tight control of conformational regulation were disengaged in the unphosphorylated system. The (P-Ser55/59)NPR1-SUMO3-WRKY70 reorients itself and forms an electrostatic and hydrogen bond with Lys145(alpha7) - (L2)Asp26, (L6)Arg99 - Leu293(L18) and Lys262(L15) - Glu241(L15), (alpha13)Val239 (alpha3(10)), & (L17)Leu267 keeps complex stable and quiescent compare to unphosphorylated NPR1-WRKY70. Subsequently, the essential dynamic and secondary structural analysis reveals that the phosphorylation inhibits the alpha5(16) (long helix) formation and reduces the communication space between the 460(alpha25-betaturn3-alpha30-L42)590 (NPR1) and 90(L9-L10)107 (SUMO3), making the binding more suitable for TGA3 (260(betaturn-L6)270) and WRKY70 (230(L15-L16)265) via activation loop. These findings, which reveal the atomic and structural details of the NPR1's post-translational modification, will illuminate future investigations into enhancing plant immunity.
abstract_zh: NPR1（非表达发病机制相关基因1）受多位点磷酸化和SUMO化调控，作为效应子触发植物免疫的主开关，通过转录激活因子（TGA3）和抑制因子（WRKY70）的作用已被实验充分研究。然而，各种磷酸化、非磷酸化状态与SUMO化在功能开关中的构象关系仍不清楚。利用基于深度学习的分子建模、对接和多纳秒模拟（总计2微秒）结合末端态自由能计算，我们揭示了不同磷酸化状态如何影响NPR1四个磷酸丝氨酸残基（Ser11、Ser15、Ser55和Ser59）的动态稳定性，以及TGA3-WRKY70在SUMO化作用下的结合情况。我们的模拟结果表明，水杨酸诱导的（P-Ser11/15）NPR1-SUMO3稳定了螺旋和柔性激活环（(α22)Lys423-(α1)Arg50和(L35)Asp467-Arg51α(5)1，以及Gly27(L3)），从而切换与TGA3的关联。磷酸化NPR1-SUMO3-TGA3之间形成的螺旋间盐桥（(L10)Arg99-Glu323(α9)和(α14)Glu280-Pro264(L6)）在构象调控中紧密控制，但在非磷酸化系统中被解除。（P-Ser55/59）NPR1-SUMO3-WRKY70重新定向，并与Lys145(α7)-(L2)Asp26、(L6)Arg99-Leu293(L18)和Lys262(L15)-Glu241(L15)、(α13)Val239(α3(10))及(L17)Leu267形成静电和氢键，与非磷酸化NPR1-WRKY70相比，保持复合物稳定且静止。随后，基本动态和二级结构分析揭示，磷酸化抑制了α5(16)（长螺旋）的形成，并减少了460(α25-β转角3-α30-L42)590（NPR1）和90(L9-L10)107（SUMO3）之间的通信空间，使结合更适合TGA3（260(β转角-L6)270）和WRKY70（230(L15-L16)265）通过激活环。这些发现揭示了NPR1翻译后修饰的原子和结构细节，将为未来增强植物免疫的研究提供启示。
